Asset: Low-angle ceiling background

Composition: 16:9 aspect ratio.

Create one upward-angled view from chest-height on the SAME running lane. Show the master station's arched ceiling, high daylight openings, linear neon lights, and consistent support structures. Match the low-angle running-face camera direction. Mild wide-angle perspective, no extreme dome distortion. No people in the foreground, no text overlays, no additional architectural systems.

Environment continuity: A photorealistic futuristic commuter station at 8:30 a.m. Inspired by the supplied image: monumental arched dark-metal roof, cyan and magenta linear lights, angular yellow doorway accents, reflective platform surfaces, luminous display panels, layered depth and faint atmospheric haze. Introduce cool diffuse morning daylight through high roof openings and the distant station mouth; retain visible neon without making it midnight. Sheltered platform, subtly damp floor, no heavy falling rain on Riley and no wet shirt. Design original architecture and signage; do not reproduce Neo-Tokyo text, reference portraits, or game franchise assets.

Working layout: Riley runs parallel to the train along the platform from screen LEFT to RIGHT. The camera remains on the platform side, on the same side of her travel axis. The train is beside the platform, behind her running lane. Select one target sliding doorway ahead of her and preserve its placement relative to roof supports and floor seams. Keep the running lane clear; no track crossing.

Rendering: Photorealistic premium live-action commercial look, physically plausible materials, believable anatomy and construction, controlled contrast, natural detail. No illustration, game screenshot, plastic skin, excessive bloom, or baked-in cinematic motion blur. Reference assets should be sharp enough to inspect. No decorative watermarks; the official contest watermark will be added during final editing.

Reference handling: Use the supplied images in the listed order and for their specified roles. Preserve selected designs; do not invent a new identity or silently replace a missing dependency.

Input images in order: station-01.
